title: Lorna Hub Inf stamina esp autofarm troll OP Script
features:
This script is in the Alpha stage; some functions may not work perfectly. I’ve chosen not to clutter the UI with icons—you can read, after all. The script is highly compatible with external and low-UNC executors (most notably Xeno and Solara). Unfortunately, it may occasionally crash after execution, and mobile compatibility hasn't been tested yet; I’d appreciate it if you could leave a comment letting me know how it runs on phones. Features Infinite Stamina (No StaminaModule modification; works well with Low UNC and external executors) ESP for Killers and Survivors (HP, Team, Name, and Highlight ESP; you may need to toggle ESP off and on again occasionally) Walkspeed and Sprint Speed ​​adjustment Full Bright Instant Proximity Prompts Auto Parry (I can't test this properly due to high ping, so I'm relying on your feedback; the trigger for some "Swing" and "Lunge" sounds works, but I can't tell if it actually manages to parry in time given the latency) IMPORTANT: Select the Parry ability before enabling Auto Parry. Survivor Aimbot: Character and Camera Lock onto the Killer. Fly Teleport Fling Anti-Fling Noclip LoopGoto (Untested) And more
This script turned out much better than the Dark Deception one—have I gained some experience?
